edges.description: The 128x128 icon file renders as a single flat, uniform medium-blue (#336699-ish steel-blue) square with no visible logo, wordmark, gradient, texture, or iconography — it is a solid color fill, not a finished brand mark.

This file is located at src-tauri/icons/128x128.png, the conventional Tauri v2 app-icon slot, so it is packaged as the application icon for the LoopDeck desktop app regardless of its current placeholder state.

A flat solid-color square with no symbol or wordmark is a strong signal of a default/placeholder icon (e.g., generated by `tauri icon` from a stock source or never customized), implying LoopDeck's visual branding/iconography has not yet been designed at the time this file was captured.

The steel/muted-blue hue could be an intentional early choice for LoopDeck's brand color (professional, calm, tech/productivity association), but with no other design elements present this cannot be confirmed as deliberate brand identity versus an arbitrary or default placeholder fill.
